dl.t: Starfield is on course to pass Witcher 3 in downloads around March 2027 (between January and March 2027), closing a 12.3M gap at about 0.10M a day.
Starfield recently moved past Fallout 3: it was behind on 26 September and ahead by 5 November 2026, and is now 7.0M clear.
Starfield is growing fastest of the games with enough history, adding 3.8% a month (0.26M downloads a day); next is Morrowind at 3.7%.
Witcher 3 is in a growth spurt: its last 90 days ran 48% above its 1-year pace. If that cools off, Starfield's pass dates come sooner.
On current trends Starfield climbs from #10 to #8 within two years (about 402.2M downloads), with #9 likely within 12 months.

mods.t: Witcher 3 is out-publishing Starfield about 4.0 to 1 and could pass it in mod count around April 2027 (later, or not at all, if the faster pace cools).
With 3,202 mods to go, Starfield should pass Fallout 3 in mod count around May 2028 (between March and May 2028).
Starfield modders published 657 mods in August–October 2026, up 3% on the same three months a year earlier.
Witcher 3 had a modding burst in October 2026: 1,587 new mods, 15.1× its usual month (105).
Witcher 3 has the fastest-growing mod library, up 8.3% a month (about 894 new mods a month).

types.t: User Interface is the type gaining the most ground: 13.5% of the last 90 days' new mods, against 6.6% of all Starfield mods.
Visuals is fading: only 2.5% of new mods, against 8.5% of all mods. Its share of all mods has fallen from 15% in January 2024 to 8.5%.
Gameplay is the biggest type (17.6% of mods) and also takes 20.5% of all downloads.
Utilities mods punch above their weight: 1.6% of mods but 3.8% of downloads (34,834 per mod).
Clothing is crowded but less downloaded: 10.6% of mods, only 5.6% of downloads.

critics.t: 81% of Starfield mods (11,395 of 14,085) are neither translations nor Star Wars mods: roughly 4 in 5.
Counting all four hot topics together (translations, Star Wars, character presets and saves, AI), 72% of Starfield mods are none of them, and those mods get 81% of downloads.
Translations are 15.7% of Starfield mods, which ranks #7 of 15 games. Translation shares are higher for Baldur's Gate 3 (35%), Bannerlord (29%), Skyrim SE (28%), Stardew Valley (27%) and 2 more.
Star Wars mods are few but popular: about 3.6% of Starfield mods (512) but 15.2% of downloads, 4× their share. That's where critics' impression comes from: not volume, but visibility.
AI-generated or AI-assisted mods are 3.8% of Starfield mods (537), #7 of 15 games, and rising fast: 25% of the last 90 days' new mods. They get 5.3% of downloads.
Players rarely download translations: they get only 0.5% of Starfield mod downloads, against 15.7% of mods.
Where critics have a point: mods tagged as related to other films, shows, books or games are 4.1% of Starfield mods, the highest share among the 15 games. That's still about 1 mod in 25.
Another point for critics: character presets and save games are 6.3% of Starfield mods (886), the highest share of the 15 games. But they get only 0.9% of downloads.

top.t: Starfield's most downloaded mod is Starfield Script Extender (SFSE) with 3,204,739 downloads (1.5× the #2, StarUI Inventory). The most endorsed is StarUI Inventory (46,054 endorsements).

The most downloaded upload of all isn't a single mod: it's the modlist Star Wars Genesis - Total Conversion Modlist, with 6.1M downloads against 3.2M for the top mod, but only 808 endorsements. Part 4 lists modlists with the collections.

Star Wars mods are the most downloaded mod in 10 of 27 categories, but the most endorsed in none. They fill 38 of the 135 top-5 places by downloads, but just 4 by endorsements: widely installed, much less often endorsed.
All 10 most endorsed mods came out in Starfield's first two months (by the end of October 2023). Early mods have had the longest to collect endorsements.

3 of the 10 most endorsed mods are script-extender tools or need it (Starfield Script Extender (SFSE), Baka Achievement Enabler (SFSE), Address Library for SFSE Plugins): Starfield's most valued mods are often the plumbing other mods build on.

Starfield's top 10 mods take 9.3% of its downloads, #7 of 15 games (middle of the pack). The range runs from Bannerlord (23%) to Skyrim SE (2%). Counting only ordinary mods (no modlists), Starfield's figure is 6.7%.
The biggest new mod of the last 90 days is Collection - Revisited patches (Miscellaneous, released 23 August 2026): 19,864 downloads so far.
